title: theta-TaN under pressure: competing phonon scattering channels

decision_points.fork: RTA vs iterative BTE (strong Normal processes)
decision_points.consequence: kappa about 45% too low at every target

decision_points.fork: Three-phonon only vs adding four-phonon scattering (large a-o gap and acoustic bunching freeze out three-phonon channels)
decision_points.wrong_choice: Omit four-phonon rates (they are withheld at 40/80 GPa)
decision_points.consequence: kappa 3-4x too high; with scalebroad 0.1 the iteration does not converge

decision_points.fork: Insulator vs semimetal: include phonon-electron scattering at the withheld 80 GPa
decision_points.wrong_choice: Drop phonon-electron scattering where its table is withheld

decision_points.fork: Units of BTE.sr_phel_metal (column 2 is 1/tau in ps^-1; column 1 is omega in rad/ps)
decision_points.wrong_choice: Treat the rate column as angular (multiply by 2 pi) when merging with the lab rates

decision_points.fork: Row order of the archived phonon-electron tables (ShengBTE irreducible list, third grid index fastest), discoverable only by comparing the archived frequency column with the lab phonons
decision_points.wrong_choice: Map rows onto the catalog irreducible list in its own order
decision_points.consequence: rates on the wrong modes: kappa -20%, share +0.17

decision_points.fork: Calculation settings: the archived CONTROL fixes 16^3 and scalebroad 0.1; the three-phonon conductivity is strongly broadening-dependent
Transfer to withheld pressures: transfer rates and solve one BTE vs interpolate conductivities (Matthiessen-like combination of separately solved results)
decision_points.wrong_choice: Interpolate released all-channel kappa in pressure (and 1/T for 600 K)

decision_points.fork: Temperature transfer of four-phonon rates to 600 K (60 GPa withheld)
decision_points.wrong_choice: Reuse 300 K rates, or scale classically by (T/300)^2

length_estimate.catalog_value_units: unbounded (any pressure/mesh/T/broadening/channel combination); fixed items alone: 6 pressures x 4 files + 6x7 harmonic + many rates

runtime_dependencies: numpy, scipy (runtime image); no extra packages
notes: References are new calculations from the archived inputs with the lab code path (tanbte.py); four-phonon rates by Monte Carlo sampling (8192 pairs per irreducible q; two seeds at 0 and 80 GPa agree to 0.1% in kappa). The paper's kappa(P) figure and the ~60 GPa maximum are not graded. The dominant defensible spread is the pressure interpolation of the withheld 80 GPa rates (+-6%).
